interpretation: One of 28 decoder blocks was fitted on 4096 calibration tokens; no trajectory optimization or empirical Fisher weighting was used.
Both candidates were frozen before assessment. No hyperparameter selection was performed on the validation panel.
Attention-only preserves closer teacher fidelity; adding the MLP chart fit increases teacher KL and changes more top choices.
Small negative NLL deltas are descriptive on this panel and do not establish an improvement.
Peak MLX memory is an observed allocator measure for these bounded runs, not whole-system memory or a guarantee.
No long-context, free-generation, multi-layer composition, task-accuracy, or throughput qualification was performed.
